summary: Iteration 4 regression on Besord: backend endpoints touched by review (DELETE /api/posts/{id}, comment upsert, vote, feed, /auth/me) all pass (10/10 pytest in test_iteration4.py). Frontend white-screen is FIXED: landing renders BESORD title, BETA badge, ONE IMAGE / ONE WORD / ONE VERDICT tagline, the static beetle mascot, and SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE button — no flying Reanimated animation. Feed renders without crashing after session injection: PostCard shows image, #WORD overlay, APROVO/DESAPROVO with counts, vote bar, share, comment input. The EDITAR + REMOVER buttons appear correctly on the 'O TEU: #WORD' row after the user comments, and EDITAR pre-fills the input. The onboarding navigation lock is FIXED — finish() redirects to /(tabs)/feed and stays there (verified at +3s/+5s/+7s, no bounce back to /onboarding), and besord_onboarded='1' is persisted in storage. Only console noise observed: deprecated 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' warnings — cosmetic, not crashing.

issues: React Native Web logs deprecation warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Visual rendering is fine; these are noise but should be migrated for forward compat.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate `shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius` to `boxShadow` in styled components (e.g. PostCard, feed header, buttons) to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional/cosmetic) Replace `pointerEvents` JSX prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` wherever still used.
No functional fixes needed for this iteration — all P0 (white-screen) and P1 (edit-comment UX, onboarding lock) items are verified resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: feed.tsx refactor cleanly extracted PostCard into /app/frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx and onDeletePost is now defined and wired to DELETE /api/posts/{id} with confirm() — no more `onDelete is not defined`.
onboardingState pub/sub correctly sets state BEFORE router.replace, eliminating the AsyncStorage race; _layout.tsx subscribes and the redirect is now deterministic (verified end-to-end).
Landing (app/index.tsx) no longer imports react-native-reanimated FlyingBesord — the static mascot loads instantly and there are no Reanimated worklet errors in the console.
Comment endpoint correctly implements upsert semantics: comments_count stays at 1 across multiple POSTs from the same user, and decrements to 0 on DELETE — covered by TestCommentUpsert.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested (landing render, feed render, vote, comment, EDITAR pre-fill, REMOVER button present, onboarding lock)

seed_data_creation: Seeded one MongoDB user `user_TEST_uitest_frontend` with session token `TEST_uitest_token_frontend_xyz` for UI auth bypass. Backend tests seed and clean their own ephemeral users/posts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the local Mongo + session-token injection trick (set localStorage.besord_token = JSON.stringify('<token>') and localStorage.besord_onboarded = JSON.stringify('1') after first navigation to localhost:3000) to bypass Google OAuth in the web preview. Test token used here: TEST_uitest_token_frontend_xyz (still in DB after this run). Feed PostCard testIDs follow the pattern post-card-{post_id}, btn-aprovo-{post_id}, btn-desaprovo-{post_id}, input-comment-{post_id}, btn-comment-{post_id}, btn-edit-comment-{post_id}, btn-delete-comment-{post_id}, btn-cancel-edit-comment-{post_id}, word-link-{post_id}. Onboarding skip has testID 'btn-skip'.
rca_of_issue: Original white-screen RCA confirmed by E1 was the undefined `onDelete` prop in feed.tsx — the rewrite that extracted PostCard and added onDeletePost in feed.tsx fully resolves it (feed renders, no JS errors). Onboarding bounce RCA was an async-storage race between writing 'besord_onboarded' and the layout's auth/onboarding gate reading it; the new pub/sub onboardingState.set(true) is called synchronously before router.replace, so the layout sees onboarded=true on the very next render and does not redirect back.
